story.title: Fight between Pooja and computer
paragraphs_en: Children story Fight between Computer and Pooja Om Parkash Kshatriya' Parkash' Pooja switched on the computer but it did not work
" What a useless box it is!", said Pooja irritatingly. A voice came over," I am not useless box. You are ! You are dependent on me. How dare you say me useless!"

" Arre! This is you who is speaking to me," said Pooja throwing a glance on computer. " How can you compare yourself with me ! you are made of 100-200 parts." " Why should not I? I am more intelligent than you. I can count any figure in a minute," said computer, " What is so special about you? Can you tell?"

" Perhaps you do not know. You are designed by a human being like me," said Pooja," My body is not made of 100-200 parts like yours." " You must tell me then how it is made of?," computer said sheepishly.
" Our body is made of 14 crores tissues and 14 billion 5 lakhs arteries." " So what!," computer said," But you can not gather more information than me in any case."

Saying this computer laughed whole heartedly. " Oh! It means you do not know that our body is very mysterious,"said Pooja," It has 6 indigo cells. The weight of brain is 3 pounds. It can collect 2-4 billion news." Now computer was dumbstruck.

Computer did not want its defeat. It said," Can you count anything in a second just like me?" " Yes! I can. If i start doing one task repeatedly, I can also perform efficiently like you." " It means, you agree that you are not efficient now," said computer.

" Yes! I am not now. Because I am busy in multitasking like playing, dancing, singing etc," said Pooja. Computer repeated ," Do you agree that you are not efficient." "Yes! But I can be," said Pooja, " Dont forget, you are designed by a human being like me."

" Yes! Here you are right," said computer. Computer had understood by now that it is creation of man. It is repaired by man. Pooja is right in that way. Any mechanic can fix me if I am damaged. So, computer started working quietly. The fight between Pooja and computer was also settled. Pooja was trying to finish her task.
